default.$description: Primary accent color — single source of truth for all accent-colored elements. Referenced by background/accent, text/accent, borders/selected/strong, and all CTA interactive states.

hover.$description: Accent color in hover state — slightly lighter than accent in dark mode, slightly darker in light mode. Referenced by all CTA hover states.

active.$description: Accent color in pressed state — strongest accent contrast. Referenced by all CTA pressed states.

primary.$description: Primary page and surface background. Most common background in the UI — used for main content areas, cards, and default surface backgrounds.

secondary.$description: Used as the second level of colors, like a layer below the primary

tertiary.$description: Deepest background level — below primary and secondary. Use for the outermost page container, app shell background, or any surface that sits behind all other layers.

soft.$description: Translucent neutral wash — off toggle track.

strong.$description: Solid neutral fill that stands out from the page in both modes — avatars, neutral tags.

elevated.$description: Surface color for elevated elements that float above the base layer — context menus, popovers, modals, tooltips, and dropdowns.

soft.$description: Subtle semi-transparent overlay (10% opacity). Use for hover state washes, row highlights, or lightweight surface tints.

strong.$description: Near-opaque overlay (80% opacity). Use for modal scrims, drawer backdrops, or strong surface overlays that obscure content behind them.

primary.$description: Primary inverted background (opposite of main background)

secondary.$description: Second-level background on inverted (dark) surfaces — slightly lighter than the primary inverted background. Use for nested layers or secondary panels inside dark surfaces.

tertiary.$description: Third-level background on inverted (dark) surfaces — the deepest/darkest layer. Use for the outermost container inside inverted sections.

hover.$description: Background for CTA buttons on hover

active.$description: Background for CTA buttons when pressed

default.$description: Default background for secondary/ghost interactive elements

hover.$description: Background for secondary interactive elements on hover

active.$description: Background for secondary interactive elements when pressed

hover.$description: Background for destructive buttons on hover

active.$description: Background for destructive buttons when pressed

default.$description: Strongest interactive fill — the primary button. Ink in light, accent in dark. The theme configurator re-points it.

hover.$description: Strongest interactive fill — the primary button. Ink in light, accent in dark. The theme configurator re-points it.

active.$description: Strongest interactive fill — the primary button. Ink in light, accent in dark. The theme configurator re-points it.

primary.$description: Always light background (never changes in light/dark mode) - primary level

secondary.$description: Always light background (never changes in light/dark mode) - secondary level

tertiary.$description: Always light background (never changes in light/dark mode) - tertiary level

primary.$description: Always dark background (never changes in light/dark mode) - primary level

secondary.$description: Always dark background (never changes in light/dark mode) - secondary level

tertiary.$description: Always dark background (never changes in light/dark mode) - tertiary level

default.$description: Subtle error background color for alerts and error states

strong.$description: Strong background color for critical error alerts and destructive actions.

default.$description: Subtle success background for success states and confirmations
Subtle warning background for warning states and alerts

primary.$description: Primary text color on inverted (or CTA) backgrounds

secondary.$description: Secondary text color on inverted backgrounds (less emphasis)

tertiary.$description: Least prominent text on dark/inverted surfaces. Use for metadata, captions, or disabled-adjacent hints where primary and secondary inverted text would be too strong

primary.$description: Primary text color that always uses the light-mode value, regardless of the current theme. Use on surfaces with a forced light background (e.g. always-light cards or illustrations).
Primary text color that always uses the dark-mode value, regardless of the current theme. Use on surfaces with a forced dark background (e.g. always-dark overlays, dark hero sections).

default.$description: Text/icon color for primary call-to-action links and buttons

disabled.$description: Text and icon color for disabled elements. Apply to labels, icons, and any foreground content inside a disabled component.

default.$description: Default text/icon color for secondary interactive elements

hover.$description: Secondary interactive text/icon color on hover

active.$description: Secondary interactive text/icon color when pressed

default.$description: Text/icon color for destructive actions and dangerous links

primary.$description: Primary text and icon color for all body content, headings, and labels. Default for any text element unless a more specific token applies.

secondary.$description: Secondary text color for less emphasized content

tertiary.$description: Tertiary text color for subtle, de-emphasized content

strong.$description: Accent color for highlighted or interactive text and icons — links, active tab labels, selected menu items. Distinct from text/interactive which is for actionable elements.
Text color for warning messages and warning states
Text color for success messages and success states
Text color for error messages and error states

primary.$description: Default border color for UI elements that have a visible boundary — inputs, cards, containers, and dividers in their resting state.

hover.$description: Border color for hovered elements that use the default border. Apply as the hover state of borders/default.

disabled.$description: Border color for disabled components. Apply to the border of inputs, buttons, cards, and any bordered element in a disabled state.

selected.$description: Subtle selection border for lightly selected items — rows, chips, or cards in a soft selected state. Less prominent than borders/selected/strong.
Strong selection border color for actively selected rows, cards, or list items. Indicates selection state, not elevation.

focus.$description: Outer focus ring color (brand accent for visual emphasis)

default.$description: Resting border of an interactive control (input, select, checkbox). Pairs with interactive-hover, -disabled, -focus. Use neutral-primary for non-interactive borders.

strong.$description: Edge of the strong fill in light; blends into the surface in dark.

soft.$description: Soft border color for inputs and form fields in an error state. Use alongside background/feedback/error/default for error form fields.

strong.$description: Strong error border for error inputs and critical states

soft.$description: Soft border color for inputs and form fields in a success state. Use alongside background/feedback/success/default for validated form fields.
Soft border color for inputs and form fields in a warning state. Use alongside background/feedback/warning/default for warning form fields.
Soft outer shadow color for subtle elevation

strong.$description: Strong outer shadow color for prominent elevation

soft.$description: Soft light inner shadow color (for highlights/emboss)

strong.$description: Strong light inner shadow color for pronounced highlight effects — embossed surfaces, pressed states, or surfaces needing a bright inner edge.

soft.$description: Soft dark inner shadow color (for debossed/inset effects)

strong.$description: Strong dark inner shadow color for pronounced inset/debossed effects — deep pressed states or surfaces needing a heavy inner shadow.

inset.$description: Inner focus ring color (provides contrast against all backgrounds)
